This is the full-production run (n_train_episodes=100, steps_per_episode=200, seeds=[42,123], real thresholds registered_c1_threshold=0.05 / registered_c3_var_threshold=0.002 -- not the smoke-test config). Reclassified evidence_direction=weakens, matching the flat copy (which was already correct) and V3-EXQ-108a's independently-reproduced weakens direction, so this run resumes weighting confidence/conflict scoring as genuine, if unfavorable, evidence.
